enchantments.tooltip: Bluff +19: Passive: +19 Competence bonus to the Bluff skill.
Seeker +11: Provides a +11 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +11 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Deception +9: +9 Enhancement bonus to hit and +14 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Melee Alacrity 15%: Gain 15% Enhancement bonus to Melee attack speed. Does not stack with the Haste spell.
Mythic Boot Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
